flag.transcripts.segments.enabled: default false: nothing is cut, the session log stays the only copy (rollback). On: cut at turn end / exit / rotation / boot catch-up, raw+projected objects to the directory store, pointer rows + transcript_segment_object.put deltas

schema.migration: additive CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ×2; measured on a copy of the live 1.15 GB store: open+migrate 10 ms

matchesApiaryS4.projectedFormat: identical header and line encoding (apiary-transcript-segment v1), zstd level 3, refs = sha256 of compressed bytes, digest = sha256 of per-line raw_sha256 digests, line numbering (blank lines skipped, CR stripped, byte offsets per file), store layout blobs/transcript-archives/<ref>
matchesApiaryS4.pointerColumns: same columns as hive_transcript_segment_objects plus path and log_segment_id

deviations: cut trigger: turn end / runtime exit / rotation / boot catch-up (Apiary cut by 1024 lines, 1 MiB or a 10-minute idle timer); the size caps still apply inside a long turn
observed_at is the cut time for every line of a segment (Honeybee does not follow lines live)
line numbers continue across a handoff's new log file; byte offsets restart per file and the row carries path + logSegmentId; epoch marks a shrunk/replaced file
pointer rows are not in the snapshot (thousands per bee); Apiary mirrors them from transcript_segment_object.put deltas plus the transcript.segments verb

projection_version is Honeybee's TRANSCRIPT_PROJECTION_VERSION (8); round two folded Apiary's compat repairs into the projector and proved byte equivalence with Apiary compat 11 (projector-equivalence.json); Apiary maps 8 <-> 11

sessionLogsOnThisNode.note: projected cost from the measured 19-30 ms/MiB: the whole corpus would take roughly 10-15 minutes of CPU spread over its turn ends; raw objects compress to 9-12 % of the log

gate.statement: a killed executor's bees read to their last segment
gate.proof: transcript-segments.1: segments cut at turn ends are byte-exact log ranges; daemon.kill(); hive transcript <bee> --from-objects --raw --data-dir reproduces every non-blank line through the last segment from the read-only store and the object directory alone, labeled STALE; a restart resumes the cursor at the next line with dense ordinals and no duplicate line

notProven: push to S3/R2: only the directory store exists behind the TranscriptObjectStore interface
Apiary consuming Honeybee's rows end to end (Apiary-side change; the format and columns match S4)
handoff rotation on a live two-harness bee (the rotation path is exercised by path-change detection logic and unit-level reasoning, not by a handoff integration test)

leadFindings.1_bootCatchUpUnbounded: every cut runs in a worker thread (v2/daemon/src/transcriptSegmentWorker.ts, bundle dist/v2/transcript-segment-worker.js) streaming 1 MiB reads (grows to 64 MiB for one long line), grouping lines across reads; the daemon thread only inserts rows; queue with maxWorkers 1 and 25 ms pacing between bees; catch-up coalesces per bee; proof: v2/daemon/tests/transcript-cut.test.ts 4/4 (cross-chunk grouping, torn tail, checkpoint restore, replay/reset), transcript-segments 3/3 through the real daemon
leadFindings.2_projectorEquivalence: ported Apiary transcriptProjectorCompat.ts + contextBaseline/Inventory/Snapshot into v2/driver-tmux/src/transcript-repairs.ts and transcript-context.ts; createTranscriptProjector wraps the harness projector with the repairs; TRANSCRIPT_PROJECTION_VERSION 7 -> 8; byte-compared Honeybee v8 vs Apiary compat 11 on real logs: claude CL.7920 6626/6626 lines identical, codex CO.5875 81/81, grok 03482fb4 8123/8123, flush identical on all three (projector-equivalence.json); checkpoint digest fixture refreshed
leadFindings.3_bootAudit: boot cuts pass audit:false to putTranscriptSegmentObject: pointer rows and cursor land, no transcript_segment_object.put delta; turn/exit cuts still audit
leadFindings.4_deferredTracksDrop: DEFERRED.md re-targeted: drop tracks in the first schema bump after the H0 release (79de4439) has run on every node for one release cycle; v52 stays additive
leadFindings.5_orphanSweepAndCapacity: sweepOrphans deletes unreferenced objects older than 1 h or any .partial, 60 s after boot once the backlog is 0, then daily; status {root, objects, bytes, orphansSwept, measuredAt} on deployInfo.transcriptSegments.objects, capacity.transcriptObjects and hive health; live counts advance per cut from the worker's created-object totals; proof: transcript-segments.1 plants a stale orphan before boot, sees it swept and the 10 live objects counted
leadFindings.6_rollback: stated in the seal: a v52 store refuses to open under the previous release (schema_newer); the open path backs the store up before migrating (store.ts), so hive deploy --rollback restores that backup; with the flag off the objects directory is never created
leadFindings.nits: zstd resolved lazily with a typed error below Node 22.15 (module loads on Node 20); transcript.segments default limit 1000, cap 10000 (invalid_request above); a final line without a trailing newline is not cut until the newline lands (contract doc)
